App information

Home Screen help

If you already have a Home Screen icon, keep using it. These steps are optional help.

  1. Open this app’s trusted HTTPS address in Safari while online.
  2. Use Share → Add to Home Screen. Enable Open as Web App if offered, then Add.
  3. Launch the Home Screen icon and stay connected until “Library saved for offline use” appears.
  4. Before relying on it offline, relaunch and check your required guide in Airplane Mode.

First online download is required.

What is saved

ServiceM8 stays separate

No live Job, customer, Asset, certificate, History or current-reading data is accessed or cached. Switch to ServiceM8 for those records. Selecting a catalogue entry does not verify the installed appliance or fuel; confirm the actual unit and setup.
